title: AI chat organizer — selector config (data only)
description: Every list is tried in order; the first selector that matches wins. Validated at runtime by lib/selectors.js (validateConfig); invalid entries are dropped and the features that need them switch off.

chatPath.description: Regexes over location.pathname with exactly one capture group: the chat id.

sidebarLink.description: Links to chats in the service's sidebar (drag source, hover button).

message.description: Root element of every message, user and assistant. Union of all selectors, in document order; nested matches are ignored.

userMessage.description: Union: a message root matching (or containing) one of these is the user's; otherwise the assistant's.

content.description: Content elements inside a message root: all outermost matches of the first selector that matches; the root itself when none matches.

strip.description: Elements skipped during conversion (buttons, hidden labels, icons); the page itself is never changed.

codeBlock.description: Container of a code block, searched for a language label when <code> has no language-* class.

codeLanguage.description: Language label inside a code block container.

title.description: Element holding the current chat title; document.title is the fallback.

titleSuffix.description: Strings removed from the end of document.title.

input.description: Prompt input (contenteditable or textarea) for the prompt library.

streaming.description: Present while an answer is being generated; indexing waits until it disappears.
